hook.q_jp:
日曜の東京、
3軒に1軒は休み
hook.q_en: Sunday in Tokyo? Nearly 1 in 3 places I track are closed
hook.say: Planning Sunday in Tokyo? Of the three hundred ten places I track in east Tokyo, ninety-six close on Sundays.

beats.sub_en: 96 of 310 close on some or all Sundays
beats.say: That's nearly one in three. Some close every Sunday, some only on certain Sundays.
Mondays are next. Fifty more close on Mondays.
Only eighty-six are open every day. Check the closed day before you go.
